environment.description: Same application container image deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode (not block), (2) a custom rule group 'app-query-sanitizer' with a single rule that uses a RegexPatternSet matching URI path '/api/users/search' combined with a ByteMatchStatement on query string for the literal string 'UNION' (case-insensitive, CONTAINS match) — action BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK mode and sensitivity level set to LOW. The task IAM role has no relevant permissions beyond ECR pull and CloudWatch logs. Container runs with read-only root filesystem; SQLite database mounted on an EFS volume with encryption at rest.
